messages:
maria_finance: Heads up 1: partner reported a 12% variance between our invoice and Azure marketplace settlement for reseller AcmeCloud. Invoice shows a $6.2k charge we don't see in the marketplace CSV. Can someone triage? @tom_ops

 tom_ops: On it. Can you drop the invoice line + marketplace file link?

 maria_finance: Uploaded here: https://files.redwood/finance/acmecloud_mar_invoice.pdf and marketplace CSV: https://files.redwood/finance/acmecloud_mar_azure_export.csv

 azure_billing_bot: Azure settlement export ready: azure-settlement-2024-03-01_2024-03-31.csv (blob://billing/azure/2024/03/).

 tom_ops: Quick scan shows the extra charge maps to SKU 'rdw.reseller.premium' but the Azure export lists it as 'rdw.reseller.premium_hourly' for certain meterlines. Might be a meterline naming/proration mismatch from their reseller flow.

 rachel_partner_ops: FYI Acme told us they did an intra-account move on 2024-03-15 at 23:50 UTC and then a seat adjustment 2024-03-16 00:10 UTC. Could be crossing our daily cutover window.

 maria_finance: If it's a cutover timing issue we may need to prorate and issue a one-off credit. Approx variance $6,180.

 tom_ops: I'll re-run the join allowing prefix matches and looking at timestamps +/- 1 day. SQL used: ```SELECT account_id, sku, SUM(quantity) as qty, MIN(event_time) AS first_seen FROM azure_meterlines WHERE account_id='acme-123' AND event_time BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31' GROUP BY 1,2;```

 tom_ops: Found 420 hours attributed to meterline 'rdw.reseller.premium_hourly' between 2024-03-15 23:00 and 2024-03-16 01:00 that our mapping dropped because mapping expected exact 'rdw.reseller.premium'.

 rachel_partner_ops: Confirmed on our side. The reseller platform appends '_hourly' for metered SKUs during moves. We didn't realize Redwood mapping was exact.

 maria_finance: OK please gather evidence and partner ack. We'll need AR ticket and approval for credit > $5k. @finance-approvals

 finance-approvals: Noted. Required: partner written confirmation, CSV diff, AR ticket. Credits over $10k need manager sign-off; this is under that threshold so normal workflow OK.

 tom_ops: Uploaded reconciliation diff: https://files.redwood/finance/reconciliations/acmecloud_mar_diff.csv. Delta = $6,180, reattributed 420 hours. Also created infra bug INF-1310 to add suffix-norm rule for Azure meterlines.

 rachel_partner_ops: Partner confirmation: "We acknowledge the intra-account move and accept reconciliation adjustment." Attached in the portal.

 maria_finance: Creating AR ticket AR-2024-0459 and attaching diff + partner confirmation. Routing to billing for credit issuance.

 finance-approvals: AR-2024-0459 received. Approving credit issuance for $6,180 pending final billing run. Please mark INF-1310 as high priority to avoid repeat.

 tom_ops: Will add unit test and deploy patch to ETL mapping tomorrow. Thanks all!
